intents.title: Upgrade actions/checkout to v5 for Node.js 24 compatibility
intents.description: Upgrade actions/checkout from v4 to v5 across .github/workflows/afwe-gate.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, and onboard.rs CI_TEMPLATE to eliminate Node.js 20 deprecation warnings on GitHub Actions runners.

claims.statement: actions/checkout is upgraded to v5 across all workflow definitions and generators
